description: This file defines a Mail class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, providing methods to configure and send emails via PHP's mail function. The class includes properties for email components like recipients, subject, body (text and HTML), and headers, along with methods for setting these components and executing the send operation.
external_files: PHP's built-in functions (e.g., mail, fopen, fclose)
PHP's core extensions (for date, string handling)

classes.name: Mail
classes.description: A class to manage email composition and dispatch within the Opencart framework, supporting plain text and HTML emails, attachments, and header configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Mail object, optionally setting properties via an options array.

methods.name: setTo
methods.description: Sets the recipient(s) of the email.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the plain text body of the email.

methods.name: setHtml
methods.description: Sets the HTML body of the email.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Compiles email headers and body, then attempts to send the email via PHP's mail() function, returning success or throwing errors if required fields are missing.
